name: WalletInsights hardware wallet security incident tracker
attribution: WalletInsights (walletinsights.io) — link to the incident's url

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Stable identifier; also the permalink path.

fields.name: affected_models
fields.description: Models in the catalog that are affected; older models are named in the text.

fields.name: type
fields.description: firmware-vulnerability, hardware-attack, supply-chain, software-vulnerability, data-breach, vendor-infrastructure or phishing.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: critical, high, medium or low; rubric on the tracker page.

fields.name: attack_vector
fields.description: remote, user-action, physical-access, supply-chain or not-applicable.

fields.name: fix_status
fields.description: fixed, mitigated, unpatchable, open or not-applicable.

fields.name: fixed_in
fields.description: Firmware or app version with the fix.

fields.name: funds_lost_usd_min
fields.description: Lowest published estimate of stolen funds, USD; empty when none was published.

fields.name: funds_lost_usd_max
fields.description: Highest published estimate, USD; equal to min or empty when estimates agree.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: Independent sources, at least two sites (CSV: separated by ' | ').

fields.name: verified_at
fields.description: Date the entry was last checked against its sources.
